title.narrative: Magnifying Competitiveness and Competences of Green-Tech Businesses in Egypt -MC2

description.narrative: Overall objective: to empower circular economy in Egypt and accelerate transition to UN2030 SDG via empowering the green technology-based solutions and enterprises. Specific Objectives: - [SO1] Building efficacy of Responsible Energy-Resources (R2E) entrepreneurial initiatives and technological solutions by dual participatory approach: - [SO1.1 - Sustainable Business & Circular Economy Think Tank: analysing resource and energy utilisation processes; empowering change-makers] - [SO1.2 - Green Innovation & Technopreneurship Hub: advancing green start-ups]; - [SO2] Setting benchmark and capitalizing R2E best practices with the aim of enhancing energy awareness and sustainable energy and resources consumption-production business patterns, demands, enabling factors & potential opportunities; - [SO3] Fostering internationalization via EU-Egypt strategic partnership making use of interactive co-operation instruments - Knowledge Management & Communication
